name: print-social-novavista-coming-soon-post-with-folded-tee-and-ruled-columns
title: Cream 'Elevate your style… Coming soon' post with a folded cream tee and justified side column
whatItIs: A square cream post with a three-line black uppercase headline and bold 'N' logo, a photo of a folded cream T-shirt in a ruled cell, a justified text column with an arrow icon, and a large 'COMING SOON' footer with URL.
whatItMeans: Understated and confident; tone-on-tone product and type tease a launch.
techniques: Match product colour to background for tone-on-tone calm.
Pair a photo cell with a justified text column.
Put the launch status as a big footer line.

vocabulary.definition: Using shades of the same colour together.
Text aligned to both left and right edges.
